notes.title: September 10th, 2025 Dev Log (Early PoS DLC Mini-Release Details!)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone. We just wanted to give you an update on what we've been up to.

We ended up getting COVID on a vacation that we took as a family in August. It blasted TheOmega with a fever higher than he's had in over a decade and he has had lingering effects from it which include vertigo and lethargy. He's gradually getting better though! All that being said, it hasn't really affected development on either of the Prince of Suburbia DLCs as we've had commissions set up several months in advance for everything.
Prince of Suburbia Re-Impregnation "Knock Me Up Again!" DLC[p align="start"]Our artist, auxiliaryout, is still working incredibly fast at creating the art for the Prince of Suburbia "Knock Me Up Again!" DLC. He's actually quite a ways ahead with the art and scenes beyond what will be in the mini-release. The final DLC sex scene count will be at least 14+ sex scenes (not including additional unique sex animations and illustrations to go with each scene). This will also include a few threesome sex scenes with characters together that have never been seen before!
[p align="start"]This Prince of Suburbia Re-Impregnation "Knock Me Up Again!" DLC will have a lot more effort going into it from a presentation perspective (art, sprite movement, etc). It will still be a kinetic/railroad visual novel experience. This time around the MC will have a POV perspective (no MC sprite) to really give the beautiful new female sprites room to shine (and to literally make room for all those Big BOOBA!).
[p align="start"]We plan to have all sex scenes voiced with erotic moans (by HaruLuna, CinderDryadVA, and maybe more!) before we're finished and to translate the game to other languages after we complete it in English first.
[p align="start"]If you're interested in this DLC, please check out our store page up on Steam and if it looks appealing to you, we'd love it if you would wishlist it by clicking HERE! It would help us a lot!

notes.title: Prince of Suburbia: Pregnancy DLC Update
notes.notes:
It's been a hot minute since we talked about our future plans for Prince of Suburbia with all of you, hasn't it? We appreciate your patience in waiting to hear about what's next.

Let's start off with the unfortunate news first. For those that don't already know, we parted ways with auxiliaryout (the most recent artist and animator for Prince of Suburbia) a few months after the release of V1.0 (the end of the main story). He is a talented artist and animator and we wish him the best of luck with his future endeavors!

So, that brings us to the next order of business. We are looking for a new illustrator and animator to help us continue the Prince of Suburbia story with a Pregnancy DLC! 

We've spent a lot of time reflecting in the past year about what players want and expect when they play Prince of Suburbia, and how to deliver the best experience possible. With that in mind, our two priorities when it comes to the future art for Prince of Suburbia are:

 An illustrator who specializes in MILFy type characters (aka BIG BOOBAS), big belly pregnancy, and adult breastfeeding/milky breasts content.
 An animator who specializes in Spine. The main game was animated using Live2D, and we feel like we pushed it to its absolute limits in terms of quality. Our understanding is that Spine has a higher ceiling in terms of quality and we want to explore that potential.Do you have any illustrators or animators you'd like to suggest we reach out to? Let us know!

We have also obviously been compiling our own list of artists we want to approach. Once we have a shortlist of artists we want to audition, we'll commission a few illustrations/animations from them and seek input from our community before moving forward.

This is your chance to help shape the future Prince of Suburbia Pregnancy DLC! We look forward to sharing more news with you as things develop, stay tuned!

notes.title: V1.0 update has released!
notes.notes:
The V1.0 update is now available!
The update has been made to both Part 1 and Part 2 of Prince of Suburbia. Thank you to all of you that entered our Global Steam Key Giveaway! Winners will be contacted by DM on Steam today.

Note: Saves will be broken.
V1.0 is a game-breaking update. We made major changes to the code with this update, including brand new GUI and upgrading to Ren'Py 8+. If your saves are broken, clicking Start in the main menu will give you a few options for different jump in points so you don't have to start from the beginning.

Using old saves, even if they open without error, may cause errors later on. Please consider starting a new game or use one of the jump in points in the title menu rather than opening old saves.
If you have any other trouble accessing the game or encounter any bugs or issues, please let us know!

The final update (V1.0) of Prince of Suburbia includes:

NEW CONTENT:
 ~20,000 words
 39 illustrations
 23 animations
 33 voice acting files (thanks to HaruLuna)

REMASTERED CONTENT:
 16 illustrations
 8 animations
 115 voice acting files (thanks to HaruLuna)
 brand new GUI (thanks to m. of Tsundere Studio)

THANK YOU to everyone who helped with this update:
 m. of Tsundere Studio for the brand spanking new GUI
 auxiliaryout, for all the art and animations
 HaruLuna, for the amazing voice acting
 Rachel Writes and Yvlan_Angel for their writing help
 Our play testers for this update: Doc62, EDHPlayer, Hondo, NeverAtone, Saniya
 All of the generous volunteers who helped improve the translated and localized versions

What's next for Prince of Suburbia?
V1.0 completes Part 2 and the main story of Prince of Suburbia. We want to make sure there are no major bugs or issues in the game (especially in the translated/localized versions) before we leave Early Access on Steam, but that is our next goal. The plan is to work on that in early 2024.

After Prince of Suburbia has left Early Access on Steam in early 2024, we will begin development on the additional Pregnancy DLC content. Stay tuned for more on that next year!

notes.title: V1.0 update is coming soon!
notes.notes:
Last week we generated the machine translations of V1.0 into all supported languages. Our generous volunteers are currently working hard to edit and improve the translations. Once the translated scripts are proofread, we'll implement them into the game and begin testing builds in all languages. If you're interested in helping with the translation process, please reach out to us on Discord!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/3a5affc51a2bc966dfcce4d2110e9a5eb562813d.png

The final update (V1.0) to the Part 2 DLC will available on Steam in all supported languages after testing is complete (likely in late November or early December). Anyone who has purchased the Part 2 DLC on Steam will receive the new content as a free update to the game as soon as it's ready.

When we started Prince of Suburbia in 2017 as a side hustle hobby project, we had no idea what it would become. While the project has had many ups and downs over the years, we couldn't be happier with where it ended up. We are incredibly excited and proud to have brought it across the finish line!

Thank you to all of our fans and supporters for coming along with us on this journey! The Prince of Suburbia story may be coming to an end, but as a studio we are just getting started.

notes.title: Prince of Suburbia: V1.0 Update + Dev Log
notes.notes:
V1.0 is almost here!
We're thrilled to announce that the Prince of Suburbia V1.0 update is almost here, with the base (English-only) version scheduled to be completed this month! The much-anticipated Steam release will follow about a month later, in November, when the translated and localized versions are complete.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/15b0c4ce0dba99ec164184edb6ec4d454dd4dc92.png
New and remastered content
V1.0 is a significant update, featuring the most extensive free roam content we've ever included in the game. We hope that this update will be a satisfying ending to the Prince of Suburbia story!

V1.0 features animated scenes for all main love interests. We're also revisiting characters who haven't been in the spotlight for a while, such as Naomi, Heather, and Lina (both versions have different art this update), each with their own animated scenes.

In addition to all the exciting new content, we've also remastered earlier parts of the game during this update cycle. This includes remastered animated lewd scenes with Sarah, Heather, and Naomi, as well as some remastered story illustrations.

notes.title: Free Update (V0.95) to Part 1 & Part 2!
notes.notes:
A FREE UPDATE has been made to both Part 1 (FREE DEMO) and Part 2 (paid DLC) of Prince of Suburbia with remastered scenes, new content, and improved translations! Watch the V0.95 trailer on YouTube for a preview of what's new in this update!

[previewyoutube=JbUT6l_5ml0;full][/previewyoutube]
The V0.95 update adds new content to both Part 1 and Part 2:
 Part 1 receives 5 remastered scenes, including 8 illustrations and 7 animations.
 Part 2 receives 6 brand new scenes, including 19,000 words of dialogue, 2 backgrounds, 55 illustrations, and 37 animations.
 The remastered content added to Part 1 will be available to access directly from the gallery if you have already unlocked those scenes (you will not need to replay any scenes you've already played). The new content added to Part 2 is a free update for anyone who has purchased the DLC.
 All of the animations in this update include voiced acted moans and sex noises by our talented voice actress, HaruLuna!Notes:
 If you encounter issues opening old saves, try starting a new game, or using the entry points in the main menu to start at the beginning of Part 2 or the V0.95 update. Save integrity is not guaranteed with each update, as the game is still in development. We also can't guarantee prior settings will be saved when making major updates to the game. These are known issues with the Ren'Py engine that are beyond our control.
 If you encounter bugs unrelated to opening old saves, or if you have purchased the Part 2 DLC and have any issues accessing the new content, please reach out to us as well. We are happy to help!
 If you downloaded V0.95 from Patreon or SubscribeStar, there is no new content in the Steam version. All that was added is the translations to other languages.We've also made big improvements to the translated versions of the game, thanks to the generous work of our volunteers. We currently support, and have improved the translations for:  Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Italian, Polish, French, German, Japanese, Portuguese, and Russian.

We are excited to announce that we are adding Turkish support with the V0.95 update! We also currently have a volunteer working on a Ukrainian translation that we hope to include with the next (V1.0) update. If you are interested in helping with the translation process, please reach out to us on Discord!

For more updates about the development of Prince of Suburbia, follow us on Patreon!

It's the biggest discount ever offered for Part 2 (Paid DLC), so mark your calendars and grab it while it's hot!

Progress continues on the last two updates to Part 2
We have some exciting progress to share about the final two updates planned for Prince of Suburbia - Part 2.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/8bf01c0f51134b5e137f81e0fadd19088fafe7b6.png
First things first, we're thrilled to announce that the art phase for the second beach update (V0.95) is now complete! Huge kudos to our talented artist, auxiliaryout, for his amazing work.

Coding for V0.95 will have to wait a bit as we finish coding an update for our other game, A Shot in the Dark, which is set to release next week. But no worries, coding and testing for Prince of Suburbia are usually the fastest part of the development cycle. Once we're done implementing all the content, we'll focus on preparing the machine translations for the Steam release.

As we expected, the art for V0.95 wrapped up before we could fully dive into writing and coding. This gave auxiliaryout a chance to get ahead on the final planned update, V1.0, and work on remastering the remaining art that needs to be remastered.

notes.title: Prince of Suburbia: March Dev Log, Progress Update & Previews
notes.notes:
Part 2 (paid DLC) currently on sale until April 3!
The Spring Sale has been extended! You can still purchase Prince of Suburbia - Part 2 (paid DLC) for 10% off through April 3. Buy it today!

Frequently asked questions
Here are some questions we get frequently from our players on Steam!

What updates are planned for Part 2 (paid DLC)?
 The first beach update (V0.9) was already added to the game last month. This update was free for all players who had previously purchased the Part 2 (paid DLC).
 The second beach update (V0.95) will be the second free update to the Part 2 (paid DLC). It will also be free for all players who have previously purchased the Part 2 (paid DLC). It's estimated release on Steam is late Spring 2023.
 The last update to the main story (V1.0) will be the last free update made to the Part 2 (paid DLC). It is estimated to release in the second half of 2023 and will be free for all players who have previously purchased the Part 2 DLC.When will the game leave Early Access? Will the price increase?
Once all of the remastered art and voice acting has been added to both Part 1 (free demo) and Part 2 (paid DLC), the game will move from Early Access to full release. Our plan is for the game to leave Early Access later in 2023.

A price increase for Part 2 (paid DLC) will likely happen at this point, more details to follow as we approach this transition. 

Are there any plans for a Part 3?
After we wrap up the main story with the V1.0 release, we plan to have additional DLC content with all of the characters, including pregnancy content. These DLCs will not continue the main story, they will be standalone scenes that take place outside of the main story. No Part 3 of the main story is planned. 

Stay tuned for more information about additional DLCs later in 2023!

Progress continues on the second beach update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/e838049f6b682f00d5b19a4a47c7e4fc030141a7.png

Art for the second beach update (V0.95) of Prince of Suburbia - Part 2 (paid DLC) is progressing on schedule! 

With the writing wrapping up for the next update of our other game, A Shot in the Dark, our team will be able to shift focus to Prince of Suburbia so we should see more progress on the writing in April. We are also looking to hire an additional writer or two to potentially help with this and/or future updates.

One of our team members who works on Prince of Suburbia has had a health emergency and will be taking the month of April off. If this causes any delays with the V0.95 development cycle, we will keep players updated. We did not anticipate releasing V0.95 in April anyway, so it's too soon to say if there will be an impact beyond that. We wish our team member a healthy and speedy recovery!

We are already planning ahead for the artwork and remastered scenes in V1.0 (the last update of the main story). Ideally, we'd like to get ahead on art so that our artist and animator can take a much-needed break to rest and heal his hand between the main game and the pregnancy/epilogue content we have planned for later this year or early next year.

If there are any delays with the release of V0.95, a silver lining is that it will likely allow us to include some of the remastered art planned for V1.0 in the V0.95 release so that we can sooner reach our goal of a fully remastered game and moving out of Early Access!

The V0.95 update includes the most complex art we've ever attempted, and we are certain it will be worth the wait! Attached to this post are some previews to whet your appetite. ;)

For more updates about the development of Prince of Suburbia, join us on Discord or check out our website.

Happy Valentine's Day to all of our Prince of Suburbia fans! A FREE UPDATE has been made to both Part 1 and Part 2 of Prince of Suburbia with remastered scenes, new content, and new translations!

Part 2 now has the V0.9 content (the first beach update). Anyone who has purchased the Part 2 paid DLC can now start the game at the beginning of the V0.9 update, jumping into the story where the previous version (V0.8) left off.

The first beach update, Part 2 - V0.9 of Prince of Suburbia includes:

 8 scenes
 ~20,000 words
 6 new backgrounds
 35 2D illustrations
 21 2D animations
 Watch the Prince of Suburbia - Part 2 (V0.9) trailer on Vimeo for a preview of what's new in this update!

With this update we are adding BETA language support for the following languages to Part 1 and Part 2. These translations are still in the testing stage, and we hope to improve them with help from our fans. If you are interested in helping edit the translations of any of the following languages please reach out to us on Discord!

 Chinese - Simplified
 French
 German
 Italian
 Japanese
 Polish
 Portuguese - Portugal
 Portuguese - Brazil
 Russian
 Spanish - Spain
 Spanish - Latam
 For more updates about the development of Prince of Suburbia, join us on Discord!
